description: This file defines the 'MulticastResult' class, which models the result of a Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) multicast message request within the Apache Fineract project. It includes properties for tracking success, failure, canonical IDs, multicast ID, as well as nested results and retry IDs. The class employs Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction and provides a builder pattern for constructing instances.

classes.name: MulticastResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a GCM multicast message request, including success and failure counts, result details, and retry multicast IDs.
